description: Add tests for tag filter chips in Platform Tools Panel and verify implementation

userStories.title: Create PlatformToolsPanel test file
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tests for the tag filter chips feature to ensure it works correctly and prevent regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Test that All chip renders and is active by default
Test that tag chips render with correct names and counts
Test that clicking a tag chip filters the tool grid
Test that clicking All clears the tag filter
Test that text search and tag filtering work together
Test that zero-count tags appear dimmed
Test that Enable All and Disable All buttons appear when a tag is active
Test that Enable All selects all filtered tools
Test that Disable All deselects all filtered tools
Test that batch buttons are hidden when All chip is active
userStories.notes: The implementation already exists in PlatformToolsPanel.tsx. This story adds test coverage.

userStories.title: Verify typecheck and lint pass
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure the existing implementation passes all code quality checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Run npx tsc --noEmit from frontend directory and confirm no errors
Run npm run lint from frontend directory and confirm no errors

userStories.title: Verify and push all changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to ensure all changes are committed and visible in the PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify if there are any remaining changes by running git status. If remaining changes exist, commit and push to branch.
